cards.headline: Cursor has an active incident: Degraded Gemini 4 Carbon
cards.detail: Status page is green but lists 1 active incident (investigating).
cards.summary: We are continuing to work with an upstream provider on intermittent errors affecting the Gemini 4 Carbon model. Some requests may fail while work on a fix continues.

cards.headline: Thinking Machines: Inkling 2 Small down 15 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: Inkling 2 Small is an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts reasoning model from Thinking Machines Lab, with 17B active parameters out of 594B total. It is the first model in the second Inkling generation.

cards.headline: Tencent: Hy3 down 10 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: Hy3 is a 295B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from Tencent (21B active, 192 experts with top-8 routing) built for reasoning, agentic workflows, and real-world production use.

cards.headline: TestSprite 4.0: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all
cards.summary: Your coding agent fixes one thing and breaks another. TestSprite 4.0 is a brand-new testing agent that remembers what your app should do and checks all of it, every time. Tell it in plain words what to test.

meta.tagline: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all

cards.headline: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL down 31 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open multimodal mixture-of-experts model from NVIDIA, with 12B active parameters out of 120B total.

cards.headline: SpaceXSI: Grok 4.7 down 6 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: Grok 4.7 is SpaceXSI's flagship model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, succeeding Grok 4.6.

cards.headline: The War Against Slop and an Emerging Weapon to Fight it: Formal Verification
cards.summary: Proving software correct with math has traditionally required specialist work. Now AI and Lean are helping automate the process.

cards.headline: Particle AI: Particle-1 down 29 ranks on OpenRouter weekly
cards.summary: Particle-1 is a token-efficient agentic coding model from Particle AI, post-trained on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

cards.headline: Netlify Server: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents
cards.summary: Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code.

meta.tagline: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents

cards.headline: S.Space: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace
cards.summary: Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor.

meta.tagline: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace

cards.headline: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
cards.detail: Tuna Han Salih Meral, Kaan Oktay, Alec Helbling et al. · cs.CV
cards.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations.

cards.headline: Appxiom: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs
cards.summary: Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you.

meta.tagline: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs

cards.headline: Zoom Slides: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides
cards.summary: Zoom Slides is an AI-powered presentation maker that turns your meetings, documents, and ideas into polished, editable decks.

meta.tagline: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides

cards.headline: Anthropic leads 7-day GitHub activity (200 events)
cards.summary: anthropics/claude-code — Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.

cards.headline: Rakazo: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own
cards.summary: Rakazo gives you AI teammates that keep working after you close the chat. Each bot has its own memory, routines and computer, with a browser you can watch and take over. Open source and self-hosted: any model, your keys, your machine. Web, desktop and mobile.

meta.tagline: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own

cards.headline: Frevana Multiplayer: AI that grows your business alongside your team
cards.summary: Frevana runs AI agent apps that find customers, create content, and automate busywork. Now it's multiplayer: invite your team with a link, share agents and skills, and build on each other's work. Your best workflow becomes everyone's.

meta.tagline: AI that grows your business alongside your team

cards.headline: Anthropics IPO: Gemischtes Fazit trotz Rekord-Börsengangs
cards.summary: Der Börsengang von Anthropic war historisch, doch der Aktienkurs sank direkt nach Handelsbeginn. Analysten wagen kaum eine Prognose, wie es weiter geht.

cards.headline: HiringNow: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.
cards.summary: HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval.

meta.tagline: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.

cards.headline: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
cards.detail: Reported by MIT Technology Review — AI (Cambridge, US).
cards.summary: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding.

cards.headline: RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B, a 27B Agentic Coding Model Trained With Reinforcement Learning Only
cards.summary: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, an Apache 2.0 agentic coding model post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B with reinforcement learning only. It more than doubles Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 to 12.0 and runs on a single GPU.

cards.headline: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
cards.summary: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery.

cards.headline: heise+ | KI beweist, dass Quantencomputer nicht allmächtig sind
cards.summary: Ein KI-Start-up hat die Aaronson-Ambainis-Vermutung bewiesen, die Quantenrechnern Grenzen setzt. Was das für Quantencomputing und Cybersicherheit bedeutet.

cards.headline: NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a Continuous Diffusion Language Model with 14 checkpoints at 3B/8B
cards.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, 14 open 3B and 8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints. Sigma denoises text in a learned 16-D embedding space, distills to few-step samplers, and decodes up to 4.20x faster than autoregressive decoding.

cards.headline: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
cards.detail: Jinbin Luo, Xiaozhe Yao, Shang Yang et al. · cs.DC
cards.summary: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory.

cards.headline: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
cards.detail: Yuxin Jiang, Wenqiang Sun, Jiaqi Li et al. · cs.CV
cards.summary: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics.

cards.headline: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
cards.detail: Deepali Singh, Deepesh Parpani, Aviral Gupta · cs.LG
cards.summary: Collecting and labeling inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for human activity recognition (HAR) is expensive, and models trained on one group of subjects often fail to generalize to unseen individuals. Even with balanced data, classifiers struggle to distinguish dynamically similar activity classes and benefit from targeted augmentation.
